profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at CafeMedia
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with full stack experience ranging from Linux drivers and hardware integration to generative AI. In my current role, I develop products aimed at helping content creators drive traffic through data-driven search engine optimization.

In my past roles, I have:
- Created automated test suites involving physical fixtures
- Implemented cutting edge deep learning research into products used in production lines around the world
- Developed firmware for aircraft power supplies

My background leans hardware, but I am eager to work and learn more in higher level spaces such as the web and generative AI.

I'm versed in several programming languages, including Python, C, TypeScript, JavaScript, bash. I have a broad knowledge of many technologies and language libraries. My favorite stack to work in is Angular / NestJ.

I'm not currently looking for a new role but I'm always happy to connect!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed prototype dashboard allowing content creators to view, filter, and drill into their data
- Built and improved data pipelines serving thousands of creators
- Developed AI tool allowing users to query their data using natural language prompts
- Built full-stack web applications using Angular/NestJS
